record_title: Half-Sobolev law for truncated diagonal Hilbert eigenstrips
provenance: Fourier-analytic refinement of the truncated diagonal-strip construction in Abakumov, Domelevo, Petermichl and Poltoratski, arXiv:2609.15155.
limitations: The theorem concerns diagonal-strip L2 profiles. Smooth cutoffs are not indicators, so the half-Sobolev improvement is functional rather than a new bounded-open-set construction. It does not classify near-invariant sets, solve quantitative stability, or cover bent-strip families. The direct source is very recent, and equivalent formulations in older product-Hardy-space language remain a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
